outcome: Number of red-cell units administered per delivery
cohort: All deliveries in Sweden between 2003 and 2017
finding: The proportion of deliveries that received red-cell transfusions was stable in Sweden between 2003 and 2017, although the number of red-cell units administered per delivery declined.
mod_finding: Red-cell transfusion was more common among nulliparous women, those who had instrumental or cesarean deliveries, and those with increased maternal age.
